g.text: Three encoding channels carry three independent facts. Shape carries kind. Height
carries criticality. Footprint area carries scale or fan-out. A channel must carry one
fact only. If height denotes kind, then height can no longer denote importance, and
the drawing loses its strongest hierarchy signal.
Shape is fixed by kind and must not be varied for emphasis. To distinguish two
components of the same kind, vary height and footprint, never shape.
Height bands: 0.8 to 1.4 peripheral, 1.8 to 2.4 working, 2.8 to 3.5 load-bearing. A
kind may render a different silhouette per band, as service does at band 3, but the
Hatch, accent and glow are reserved. Hatch denotes ownership. Accent denotes the
critical path. Glow denotes the single authority. Do not spend these channels on
Every sheet must cite the profile and version in the title block. A drawing that does
not cite its profile is not drawn to a standard.
SHAPE DENOTES KIND — DIMENSION DENOTES MAGNITUDE — PROFILE SW-1.0
